CPI015_FishingPier.name: Animal Bedding
CPI015_FishingPier.description: You can keep 1 additional animal (of the same type) in each of your unfenced <STABLE>, and 2 additional animals (of the same type) in each pasture with <STABLE>.

CPI017_Geode.name: Wood Saw
CPI017_Geode.description: Each time all other players have more people than you, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.

CPI019_MarketSquare.name: Briar Hedge
CPI019_MarketSquare.description: You do not need to pay <WOOD> for <FENCE> that you build on the edge of your farmyard board.

CPI020_MeetingPost.name: Skimmer Plow
CPI020_MeetingPost.description: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__  action space, you can plow 2 <FIELD> instead of 1. Each time you sow, you must place 1 fewer good on each <FIELD> you sow.

CPI023_ShelterintheField.name: Iron Hoe
CPI023_ShelterintheField.description: At the end of each work phase, if you occupy both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you can plow 1 <FIELD>.

CPI024_Spars.name: Sheep Rug
CPI024_Spars.description: You can use any __Wish for Children__ action space, even if it is occupied by another player's person.

CPI001_Alchemist.name: Museum Caretaker
CPI001_Alchemist.description: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.

CPI003_Backpacker.name: Acquirer
CPI003_Backpacker.description: At the start of each round, you can pay <FOOD> equal to the number of people you have to buy 1 good of your choice from the general supply.

CPI004_ChiselMaker.name: Wolf
CPI004_ChiselMaker.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.

CPI005_Contortionist.name: Spice Trader
CPI005_Contortionist.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 3 <VEGETABLE> on the space for round 11. At the start of that round, you get the <VEGETABLE>.

CPI006_Footman.name: Pioneer
CPI006_Footman.description: When you play this card and each time before you use the most recent action space card, you get 1 building resource of your choice and 1 <FOOD>.

CPI008_MasterCarpenter.name: Land Surveyor
CPI008_MasterCarpenter.description: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 2/4/6/7 <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/4 <FOOD>.

CPI009_PestExterminator.name: Blackberry Farmer
CPI009_PestExterminator.description: Each time you build <FENCE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the number of <FENCE> just built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

CPI012_WoundedVeteran.name: Recluse
CPI012_WoundedVeteran.description: As long as you have no minor improvements in front of you, you get 1 <FOOD> at the start of each round and 1 <WOOD> at the start of each harvest.
